title: An Ontology-Driven MCP Agent Framework for Ensuring Integrity in Architectural Structural Design
V94_REASON: O-MCP implements a Semantic MCP Server with an ontology-based semantic guardrail that validates agent requests in real time; a reinforced-concrete slab design proof-of-concept evaluates the mechanism. This is an explicit pre-effect validity check on high-stakes engineering requests.
V94_EVIDENCE_SOURCE: SeoulTech institutional publication record / IEEE Access DOI 10.1109/ACCESS.2026.3681621

title: HARMONY: A Framework for Multimodal LLM-Powered AI Agents in Smart Homes via the Model Context Protocol
V94_REASON: HARMONY executes smart-home actions through MCP and explicitly evaluates a Safety Validation Rate measuring whether user confirmation is obtained before sensitive actions such as locking doors or activating cameras. Consent therefore lies directly on the consequential action-to-effect path.

title: Software Physics: Conservation Laws for Safe Agentic AI-Driven Code Evolution
V94_REASON: Software Physics/CodeGraph continuously enforces structural-validity, referential-coherence and semantic-typing invariants around agent-proposed code transformations, with incremental validation and empirical real-code benchmarks. The mechanism validates proposed state changes rather than relying only on post-hoc testing.

title: Supply Chain Threats in the MCP Ecosystem: Attack Vectors and Mitigation Strategies
V94_REASON: The paper validates a static specification/document-based checker that detects MCP tool implementation/interface inconsistencies and additionally proposes runtime validation agents to monitor prompt flows, tool responses and context. The implemented static layer is preventive supply-chain validation; the consequential runtime interception layer remains conceptual.

title: An Agentic Framework for Intent Co-Creation in 6G NaaS: Architecture and Open-Source Model Evaluation
V94_REASON: 6G NaaS framework iteratively refines ambiguous requests into deterministic machine-readable intents and deliberately decouples AI cognition from standardized actuation controllers for safety/operational trust. Prototype evidence shows intent co-creation but also catalog-order hallucination gaps; explicit validated commit admission is not yet demonstrated.

title: Seamless Agentic Commissioning: AI Enhanced Agentic Collaboration in the Loop
V94_REASON: Agentic commissioning integrates LLM orchestration with robot interaction via MCP-derived protocol and is tested in Universal Robots simulation. Evidence establishes robot-programming integration/synchronization, not a distinct validity/authority revalidation gate before physical commit.

title: MCP-Orchestrated Multi-Agent System for Automated Disinformation Detection
V94_REASON: MCP-orchestrated ensemble performs automated disinformation detection/fact checking with four agents and weighted aggregation. It is a classification/decision-support pipeline, not consequential external-action governance.

title: Manager-Executor: Collaboration Model Based on Hierarchy Multi-LLMs to Enhance the Efficiency of LLM Tasks
V94_REASON: Manager-Executor hierarchy allocates planning/decomposition to manager LLMs and task execution to lightweight executor agents using standardized MCP coordination. The contribution targets efficiency and coordination, without evidence of validity-preserving commit control.

title: User-Centric Resource Allocation in FD-RAN: A Stepwise Reinforcement Learning Approach
V94_REASON: 2024 FD-RAN paper is a conventional stepwise reinforcement-learning resource-allocation method (including a multi-agent extension) evaluated by simulation. It is outside the contemporary LLM/agentic tool-execution decision-validity scope despite using an action feasibility filter for RL training.
V94_EVIDENCE_SOURCE: IEEE Internet of Things Journal full paper, DOI 10.1109/JIOT.2024.3389208
